in_hebrew.name: Carlene
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Dear one, man of the rock
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Carlene הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Carlene is derived from the Old German name Karl, meaning man, and the Latin name Helena, meaning shining light or the sun. In the Christian tradition, Carlene is a name for a strong, virtuous woman who is kind, faithful, and loyal.
